name: ladder-321-tiered-rounds
rawText:
METCON - THE LADDER
3-2-1 rounds for time:

x3 rounds:
600m Echo Bike
8 alt' DB Snatch
8 Weighted Step Ups
8 Toes to Bar

x2 rounds:
900m Echo Bike
12 alt' DB Snatch
12 Weighted Step Ups
12 Toes to Bar

x1 round:
1800m Echo Bike
24 alt' DB Snatch
24 Weighted Step Ups
24 Toes to Bar

Cash out: 200 D.U. / 400 singles

Same DB @17.5kg for the snatches and the step ups
